schema_front.purpose: The corpus schema as the proposer's working instructions: DocRED's closed entity-type inventory and 96-relation inventory. Pack candidate payload (DocRED pack, issue #66 stage 3): relation definitions authored from the denoted Wikidata property's semantics and train-gold usage; endpoint signatures and directionality derived from the TRAIN split (fitting side) — dev is never used for fitting.

entity_inventory.definition: A person: a named individual human, including historical, fictional, or legendary persons referred to as individuals in the text.
An organization: a company, institution, agency, band, team, political party, or other named group with a collective identity.
A location: a country, city, region, building, facility, or geographical feature.
A point or span of time: a date, year, month, century, or named period.
A numeric quantity: a count, measurement, sum, percentage, or ranking expressed in digits or number words.
Any other named entity that is not PER, ORG, LOC, TIME, or NUM: creative works, events, laws, awards, products, languages, ethnic or religious groups, and similar referents.

relation_inventory.definition: The head of government of the subject polity (country, state, city, or other governmental body): the subject is the polity, the object is the person who heads its executive government.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 358/368 (97%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->PER (4), LOC->LOC (3), LOC->MISC (2).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Distinct from head of state: a president who is both head of state and head of government takes both relations; a prime minister serving under a monarch takes only this one.

relation_inventory.definition: The sovereign country the subject belongs to or is located in: the object is the country, whatever the subject is (place, organization, person, work).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 9036/14401 (63%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->LOC (3921), MISC->LOC (1214), PER->LOC (69).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: For a city or region this is its country. Do not confuse with 'located in the administrative territorial entity', which names the immediate administrative unit at any level (province, state, city).

relation_inventory.definition: The place where the subject person was born: subject is a person, object is the place.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 686/692 (99%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->LOC (4), PER->ORG (1), MISC->LOC (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The place where the subject person died: subject is a person, object is the place.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 271/281 (96%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->MISC (6), LOC->LOC (2), PER->ORG (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The subject's father: the subject is the child, the object is the father (person -> person).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 450/466 (97%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->LOC (4), MISC->MISC (4), PER->ORG (2).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Direction is child -> father. The reverse viewpoint (parent -> child) is 'child'.

relation_inventory.definition: The subject's mother: the subject is the child, the object is the mother (person -> person).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 161/168 (96%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->MISC (5), PER->MISC (2).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Direction is child -> mother. The reverse viewpoint (parent -> child) is 'child'.

relation_inventory.definition: The subject's spouse (husband or wife): person -> person. The relation is symmetric: it holds in both directions and either endpoint order is correct.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 622/640 (97%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->PER (5), PER->MISC (5), PER->LOC (3).

relation_inventory.definition: The country of which the subject person is a citizen: person -> country.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 4499/4665 (96%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->MISC (47), PER->ORG (36), LOC->LOC (34).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Citizenship is a legal fact about the person; do not substitute birthplace, residence, or the country a person is merely associated with.

relation_inventory.definition: The continent on or in which the subject is located: the subject is a place, the object is a continent.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 737/761 (97%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->LOC (16), MISC->LOC (5), LOC->ORG (2).

relation_inventory.definition: The subject is an individual instance of the object class or type (a specific ship -> 'aircraft carrier'; a specific award ceremony -> 'award ceremony').
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 138/225 (61%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->ORG (39), LOC->LOC (20), ORG->MISC (9).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Distinct from 'subclass of', where the subject itself is a class. If the subject is a unique named individual, use instance of.

relation_inventory.definition: The head of state of the subject polity: the subject is the polity, the object is the person (monarch, president) who is its formal head of state.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 275/292 (94%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->PER (8), MISC->PER (4), LOC->ORG (2).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: See 'head of government' for the contrast: the head of government runs the executive; the head of state is the polity's formal head. One person can hold both.

relation_inventory.definition: The capital city of the subject polity: the subject is a country, state, or region, the object is its seat of government (place -> place).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 171/178 (96%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->LOC (4), MISC->LOC (1), LOC->PER (1).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Inverse is 'capital of', where the city is the subject. Check which side the text makes the subject.

relation_inventory.definition: A language with official status in the subject country or organization: the object is the language.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 191/281 (68%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->LOC (67), ORG->MISC (11), MISC->LOC (5).

relation_inventory.definition: A position, office, or role the subject person holds or held: the object is the position itself (e.g. 'President of France', 'member of parliament').
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 30/49 (61%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->ORG (12), PER->PER (4), PER->LOC (3).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: The object is the position, not the organization. Working for an organization is 'employer'; belonging to it is 'member of'.

relation_inventory.definition: The subject's child: the subject is the parent, the object is the child (person -> person).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 671/703 (95%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->MISC (9), LOC->PER (8), PER->MISC (5).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Direction is parent -> child; the reverse viewpoints are 'father' and 'mother'.

relation_inventory.definition: The author of the subject work: the subject is a written work (book, article, text), the object is the person who wrote it.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 463/489 (95%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->PER (14), LOC->PER (4), ORG->PER (3).

relation_inventory.definition: A sports team the subject athlete belongs or belonged to: person -> sports team/organization.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 348/379 (92%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->LOC (16), NUM->ORG (6), ORG->ORG (3).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Use instead of 'member of' when the group is a sports team; use 'member of political party' for parties.

relation_inventory.definition: The director of the subject film or directed work: the subject is the work, the object is the person who directed it.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 331/341 (97%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->PER (4), LOC->PER (3), ORG->PER (3).

relation_inventory.definition: The screenwriter of the subject film or work: the subject is the work, the object is the person who wrote its screenplay.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 234/237 (99%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->PER (2), LOC->PER (1).

relation_inventory.definition: An educational institution the subject person attended or was educated at: person -> institution.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 468/503 (93%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->LOC (34), PER->PER (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The composer of the subject musical work: the subject is the work, the object is the person who composed the music.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 169/171 (99%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->PER (1), NUM->PER (1).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: For the words of a song use 'lyrics by'; for the music, composer.

relation_inventory.definition: The political party the subject person is a member of: person -> party.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 387/403 (96%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->MISC (8), LOC->ORG (4), MISC->ORG (1).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Use instead of 'member of' when the group is a political party.

relation_inventory.definition: The organization the subject person works or worked for: person -> organization.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 403/421 (96%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->LOC (15), PER->MISC (3).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Founding a company is not employment: from the company's side that is 'founded by'.

relation_inventory.definition: A founder of the subject organization: the subject is the organization, the object is the person (or organization) who founded it.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 140/204 (69%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->PER (26), LOC->PER (13), PER->MISC (9).

relation_inventory.definition: The league or competition series in which the subject sports team or athlete competes: the object is the league.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 297/356 (83%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->MISC (33), LOC->ORG (8), ORG->LOC (6).

relation_inventory.definition: The publisher of the subject work or periodical: the subject is the work, the object is the publishing organization or person.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 254/298 (85%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->MISC (15), PER->ORG (12), MISC->PER (7).

relation_inventory.definition: The owner of the subject: the subject is the thing owned (organization, property, work), the object is the person or organization that owns it.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 198/389 (51%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->ORG (105), LOC->ORG (47), LOC->LOC (16).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Direction: owned thing -> owner.

relation_inventory.type: located in the administrative territorial entity
relation_inventory.definition: The administrative territory the subject is located in: the object is the containing administrative unit at any level (a city in a province, a site in a country, an organization in its city).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 14981/20402 (73%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->LOC (5091), MISC->LOC (178), LOC->ORG (65).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Extract every containment the text states, at each stated level. The inverse viewpoint (territory -> what it contains) is 'contains administrative territorial entity'. Do not use for bodies of water — that is 'located in or next to body of water'.

relation_inventory.definition: The genre of the subject creative work: the subject is a work, the object is the genre.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 123/239 (51%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->MISC (71), ORG->MISC (30), PER->LOC (6).

relation_inventory.definition: The organization that operates the subject (a facility, service, network, or vehicle): the subject is the operated thing, the object is the operating organization.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 76/192 (40%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->ORG (73), ORG->ORG (31), LOC->LOC (7).

relation_inventory.definition: The religion or religious denomination the subject person or group adheres to: the object is the religion.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 232/357 (65%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->ORG (46), LOC->ORG (38), PER->LOC (16).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: The object is the religion itself, not a place of worship and not a religious organization the person belongs to.

relation_inventory.definition: An administrative territory contained in the subject: the subject is the larger territory, the object is the contained unit (place -> place).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 3277/3369 (97%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->LOC (46), LOC->ORG (24), MISC->LOC (9).
relation_inventory.inverse_of: located in the administrative territorial entity
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Inverse of 'located in the administrative territorial entity'.

relation_inventory.definition: The subject immediately follows the object in a sequence (in a series, in office, in a sequence of events): the subject comes after the object.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 393/506 (78%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->ORG (54), LOC->LOC (42), TIME->TIME (6).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Inverse is 'followed by'. The subject is the later element.

relation_inventory.definition: The subject is immediately followed by the object in a sequence: the subject comes before the object.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 393/506 (78%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->ORG (54), LOC->LOC (42), TIME->TIME (6).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Inverse of 'follows'. The subject is the earlier element.

relation_inventory.definition: The place where the subject organization's headquarters is located: organization -> place (city or site).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 230/263 (87%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->LOC (14), MISC->LOC (12), LOC->ORG (2).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: The stated headquarters place, not merely the country the organization is from — that is 'country' / 'country of origin'.

relation_inventory.definition: A cast member of the subject film, series, or production: the subject is the work, the object is the performing person.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 882/919 (96%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->PER (21), ORG->PER (7), LOC->PER (4).

relation_inventory.definition: A producer of the subject film or production: the subject is the work, the object is the person who produced it.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 231/249 (93%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->ORG (10), ORG->PER (3), MISC->MISC (2).

relation_inventory.definition: An award the subject received: the subject is the person or work honored, the object is the award.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 279/340 (82%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->MISC (43), PER->ORG (5), LOC->MISC (5).

relation_inventory.definition: The creator of the subject (a work, character, or thing): the subject is the created thing, the object is the person or organization that created it.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 193/410 (47%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->PER (173), PER->ORG (15), LOC->PER (15).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Prefer the specific role the text states when the inventory offers it (author, director, composer, screenwriter, lyrics by); creator is the general case.

relation_inventory.definition: The immediate parent taxon of the subject taxon in a biological classification: subject and object are both taxa.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 107/117 (91%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->MISC (5), MISC->LOC (4), LOC->LOC (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The ethnic group the subject person belongs to: person -> ethnic group.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 56/155 (36%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->ORG (37), PER->LOC (32), PER->ORG (19).

relation_inventory.definition: A performer of the subject musical work or recording: the subject is the work or recording, the object is the performing person or group.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 800/1773 (45%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->PER (766), PER->PER (126), MISC->MISC (56).

relation_inventory.definition: The manufacturer of the subject product or material: the subject is the product, the object is the manufacturing organization.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 134/144 (93%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->LOC (6), ORG->ORG (2), LOC->ORG (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The developer of the subject (software, product, or project): the subject is the thing developed, the object is the developing person or organization.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 368/402 (92%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->PER (21), ORG->ORG (7), PER->ORG (4).

relation_inventory.definition: The series the subject work belongs to: the subject is a work (book, film, episode), the object is the series.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 224/245 (91%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->PER (11), ORG->MISC (3), MISC->LOC (2).

relation_inventory.definition: A sister (twin) city of the subject place: place -> place. The relation is symmetric: either endpoint order is correct.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 8/8 (100%) of train triples for this relation.

relation_inventory.definition: The legislative body of the subject polity (its parliament or legislature): the subject is the polity, the object is the legislative organization.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 277/305 (91%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->ORG (17), LOC->MISC (7), LOC->LOC (3).

relation_inventory.definition: A country in the drainage basin of the subject watercourse or body of water: the subject is the river or water body, the object is a country it flows through or drains.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 169/174 (97%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->ORG (3), LOC->MISC (1), LOC->PER (1).

relation_inventory.type: located in or next to body of water
relation_inventory.definition: The body of water the subject place is located in or next to: the subject is a place, the object is the water body (place -> place).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 421/431 (98%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->LOC (5), MISC->LOC (2), LOC->PER (1).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Distinct from 'located in the administrative territorial entity': here the object is water, not an administrative unit.

relation_inventory.definition: The military branch (army, navy, air force, and similar) the subject (a unit, person, or organization) belongs to: the object is the branch.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 160/191 (84%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->ORG (20), PER->LOC (4), ORG->LOC (2).

relation_inventory.definition: The record label of the subject recording, album, or performer: the object is the label organization.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 524/923 (57%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->ORG (247), ORG->ORG (123), MISC->MISC (10).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: The label must be stated for this subject. A song does not inherit the label of the album it appears on unless the text states it for the song (the gold audit's B-008 trap).

relation_inventory.definition: A production company behind the subject film or production: the subject is the work, the object is the company.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 134/152 (88%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->ORG (6), ORG->ORG (5), MISC->MISC (3).

relation_inventory.definition: The location of the subject (where a thing, event, or organization is situated) when no more specific location relation in this inventory applies: the object is the place.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 327/336 (97%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->ORG (4), MISC->MISC (3), LOC->ORG (1).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Prefer the specific relations when they fit: 'headquarters location' for headquarters, 'located in the administrative territorial entity' for administrative containment, 'narrative location' for a work's setting.

relation_inventory.definition: The subject is a class that is a subclass of the object class: both endpoints are classes or types.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 92/152 (61%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->ORG (41), MISC->LOC (8), MISC->ORG (2).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Distinct from 'instance of', where the subject is an individual member of the class.

relation_inventory.definition: A subsidiary of the subject organization: the subject is the parent organization, the object is the subsidiary (organization -> organization).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 191/230 (83%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->MISC (25), ORG->LOC (4), LOC->ORG (3).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Inverse is 'parent organization', where the subsidiary is the subject.

relation_inventory.definition: The subject is part of the object (a work in a series, a component in a whole, a unit in an organization): the object is the whole.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 611/2112 (29%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->MISC (536), LOC->LOC (501), ORG->ORG (215).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Inverse is 'has part'.

relation_inventory.definition: The original language of the subject creative work: the subject is a work, the object is the language.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 55/107 (51%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->LOC (43), LOC->MISC (3), PER->MISC (3).

relation_inventory.definition: A platform the subject software or video game runs on or was released for: the subject is the software, the object is the platform.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 438/460 (95%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->MISC (10), MISC->ORG (9), MISC->NUM (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The body of water into which the subject watercourse flows (its mouth): the subject is the river or stream, the object is the receiving water body.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 199/200 (100%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->LOC (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The original network or channel that first broadcast the subject television work: the subject is the work, the object is the network organization.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 211/264 (80%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->MISC (34), PER->ORG (10), LOC->ORG (4).

relation_inventory.definition: The subject is a member of the object organization or group: the object is the group.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 933/1299 (72%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->ORG (245), ORG->ORG (32), PER->MISC (31).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Use the specific variants when they apply: 'member of sports team' for teams, 'member of political party' for parties.

relation_inventory.definition: The chairperson of the subject organization: the subject is the organization, the object is the person who chairs it.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 141/145 (97%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->PER (3), LOC->PER (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The country where the subject (a work, product, or organization) originates: the object is the country.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 931/948 (98%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->LOC (13), MISC->MISC (3), MISC->ORG (1).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: For creative works this is the producing country. Distinct from 'country' used for where a place or entity is located.

relation_inventory.definition: The subject has the object as a part or component: the object is the part.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 716/2313 (31%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->PER (611), LOC->LOC (501), ORG->ORG (215).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Inverse of 'part of'.

relation_inventory.definition: The place where the subject person resides or resided: person -> place.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 62/66 (94%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->ORG (2), ORG->LOC (2).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Residence is where a person lives; do not substitute birthplace ('place of birth') or where they work ('work location').

relation_inventory.definition: The date on which the subject person was born: the subject is a person, the object is the date itself.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 1161/1172 (99%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->TIME (4), MISC->TIME (4), ORG->TIME (2).

relation_inventory.definition: The date on which the subject person died: the subject is a person, the object is the date itself.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 988/1000 (99%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->TIME (5), LOC->TIME (4), ORG->TIME (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The date the subject (an organization, work, or thing) was founded, created, or came into existence: the object is the date.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 461/868 (53%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->TIME (225), MISC->TIME (177), PER->TIME (3).

relation_inventory.definition: The date the subject organization or structure ceased to exist (was dissolved, abolished, or demolished): the object is the date.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 102/181 (56%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->TIME (60), MISC->TIME (18), PER->TIME (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The date the subject work was published or released: the subject is a work, the object is the date.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 1596/1621 (98%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->TIME (13), PER->TIME (9), LOC->TIME (3).

relation_inventory.definition: The date or time at which the subject (an event, term, or period) started: the object is the time.

relation_inventory.definition: The date or time at which the subject (an event, term, or period) ended: the object is the time.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 99/105 (94%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->TIME (5), TIME->TIME (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The point in time at which the subject event occurred or a dated fact about the subject holds, when no more specific date relation in this inventory applies: the object is the time.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 174/191 (91%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->TIME (12), ORG->TIME (4), PER->TIME (1).

relation_inventory.definition: A conflict or war the subject (a person, military unit, or vessel) took part in: the object is the conflict.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 278/575 (48%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->MISC (231), MISC->MISC (31), LOC->MISC (24).

relation_inventory.definition: A character appearing in the subject work: the subject is the work, the object is the (usually fictional) character.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 330/370 (89%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->MISC (14), PER->PER (11), LOC->PER (8).

relation_inventory.definition: The lyricist of the subject song or musical work: the subject is the work, the object is the person who wrote the lyrics.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 78/79 (99%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->ORG (1).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: For the music itself use 'composer'; for the words, lyrics by.

relation_inventory.definition: The terrain feature (mountain, island, plain, and similar) on which the subject place is located: place -> place.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 279/293 (95%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->LOC (8), ORG->LOC (3), NUM->LOC (2).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Distinct from 'located in the administrative territorial entity': the object is a physical terrain feature, not an administrative unit.

relation_inventory.definition: A participant in the subject event: the subject is the event, the object is the participating person or organization.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 599/1168 (51%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->ORG (274), MISC->LOC (219), MISC->MISC (42).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Inverse is 'participant of', where the participant is the subject.

relation_inventory.definition: The subject was influenced by the object (a person, work, or movement): the object is the influence.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 15/22 (68%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->MISC (5), MISC->PER (1), ORG->ORG (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The place where the subject organization was formed or founded: organization -> place.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 91/102 (89%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->LOC (5), PER->LOC (2), LOC->LOC (2).

relation_inventory.definition: The parent organization of the subject organization: the subject is the subsidiary or member organization, the object is the parent (organization -> organization).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 191/230 (83%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->ORG (25), LOC->ORG (4), ORG->LOC (3).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Inverse of 'subsidiary'.

relation_inventory.definition: A notable work of the subject person — a work they are known for: the subject is the person, the object is the work.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 1975/3055 (65%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->MISC (808), PER->PER (151), MISC->MISC (62).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Roughly the reverse viewpoint of 'creator' / 'author', where the work is the subject.

relation_inventory.definition: The subject separated from the object (a territory, state, or organization that split off from another): the subject is the part that separated, the object is the entity it separated from.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 6/8 (75%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->ORG (2).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Direction follows the separation: the part that left is the subject.

relation_inventory.definition: The place where the subject work's narrative is set: the subject is a (fictional) work, the object is the setting.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 76/83 (92%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->LOC (2), ORG->LOC (2), LOC->LOC (2).

relation_inventory.definition: The place where the subject person works or worked (their workplace location): person -> place.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 190/204 (93%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->ORG (11), ORG->LOC (1), LOC->PER (1).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Distinct from 'residence', where the person lives.

relation_inventory.definition: The jurisdiction to which the subject (a law, tax, or rule) applies: the subject is the legal item, the object is the jurisdiction.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 584/1207 (48%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->LOC (483), MISC->LOC (68), ORG->ORG (28).

relation_inventory.definition: A product or material the subject organization produces: the subject is the producing organization (or place), the object is the product or material.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 59/65 (91%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->ORG (6).

relation_inventory.definition: The unemployment rate of the subject place (at the time the text states): the subject is a place, the object is the rate (a number).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 1/2 (50%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->TIME (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The subject territory is claimed by the object (the country or organization claiming it): the subject is the territory, the object is the claimant.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 51/59 (86%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->ORG (4), LOC->MISC (2), PER->LOC (1).

relation_inventory.definition: The subject participated in the object event: the subject is the person or organization, the object is the event.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 599/1168 (51%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->MISC (274), LOC->MISC (219), MISC->MISC (42).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Inverse of 'participant'.

relation_inventory.definition: The subject replaces the object (a predecessor in office, an earlier version, a superseded body): the subject is the successor, the object is what it replaces.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 70/96 (73%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->ORG (15), MISC->MISC (4), LOC->ORG (3).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Inverse is 'replaced by'.

relation_inventory.definition: The subject was replaced by the object: the subject is the predecessor, the object is the successor.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 70/96 (73%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->ORG (15), MISC->MISC (4), ORG->LOC (3).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Inverse of 'replaces'.

relation_inventory.definition: The subject is the capital of the object polity: the subject is the city, the object is the country or state (place -> place).
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 171/178 (96%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: LOC->ORG (4), LOC->MISC (1), PER->LOC (1).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Inverse of 'capital'; the pair is the same, the direction decides the label.

relation_inventory.definition: A language the subject person (or population) speaks, writes, or signs: the object is the language.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 236/366 (64%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: PER->LOC (116), LOC->MISC (6), LOC->LOC (5).

relation_inventory.definition: The subject (a person, place, or thing) is present in, or appears in, the object work: the subject is what appears, the object is the work it appears in.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 580/669 (87%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: MISC->MISC (27), ORG->MISC (17), PER->PER (15).
relation_inventory.extraction_intent: Presence does not transfer between wholes and parts: a subject stated to appear in an album is not thereby present in each of its songs unless the text states it (the gold audit's B-008 trap).

relation_inventory.definition: A sibling of the subject person: person -> person. The relation is symmetric: either endpoint order is correct.
relation_inventory.signature_note: Train gold: the modal endpoint pattern covers 702/712 (99%) of train triples for this relation. Other attested patterns: ORG->ORG (2), PER->LOC (2), LOC->PER (2).

merge_prohibitions.rule: Never merge entities of different schema types.
